D.t: Jason Crow leads by 30.8 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 109,527 votes; a one point swing is about 1,776 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +23.1 and D +37.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
